extension.summary: Apple TV+ and iTunes client for Kodi (experimental)
extension.description:
Sign in with your Apple ID and browse Apple TV+ originals and your iTunes movie library, playing back through InputStream Adaptive with Widevine DRM.
EXPERIMENTAL: Apple provides no public API. This addon mimics the Apple TV web/Android client to receive Widevine-protected streams (the only DRM Kodi can decrypt). Because Kodi only ships the software Widevine L3 CDM, playback quality is limited to standard definition; HD/4K require the hardware DRM found only on Apple devices. Apple ID sign-in, 2FA and the playback endpoints depend on Apple's private, undocumented services and may need updating whenever Apple changes them.
Features: * Apple ID sign-in with two-factor authentication * Browse Apple TV+ Originals (shows and movies) * Browse your iTunes purchased/rented movie library * Search the Apple TV catalogue * Widevine playback via InputStream Adaptive

extension.news: 2026.7.31.11 - Trailers play - FIX: Trailers carry no DRM at all -- no key of any kind in the manifest. The addon was still asking InputStream Adaptive for a Widevine session, which then waited for a licence that could never arrive. Streams with no keys now play as plain HLS. - Trailers play at full quality: the 360-line, H.264 and SDR limits exist only to satisfy the Widevine CDM, which an unencrypted stream never reaches. - FIX: Key collection read its key from the first variant in the manifest, which is usually one the quality filter drops. Since Apple keys each tier separately, that was the wrong key. It now reads from the variants that are actually played, and says so in the log when a stream has no keys. 2026.7.31.10 - Watch history syncs to your Apple account - NEW: What you watch through the addon now updates Apple's Continue Watching, and resumes at the right place on your other Apple devices. Progress is reported every 30 seconds and once more when playback stops; past 95% the title counts as finished. Trailers and bonus features are never reported. - The utsk session token is now requested from Apple's own configurations endpoint when the web shell does not carry one, instead of relying on scraping alone. 2026.7.31.9 - Follow clubs and manage Up Next - NEW: Context menu on an MLS club follows or unfollows it. - NEW: Context menu on any title, episode or sporting event adds it to Up Next or removes it. - Both directions are offered rather than one toggle, because Apple gives no way to read back what is already followed or listed. Neither sends anything unless you are signed in. 2026.7.31.8 - MLS club pages open - NEW: The 30 clubs under "Browse All Clubs" are folders now. Each opens its team page: Featured, Matches, Past Matches, Every Goal, best-of reels and player compilations. 2026.7.31.7 - Browse categories (rooms) open - NEW: The category tiles under "Browse All Apple Originals" -- Kids & Family, Sci-Fi, Comedies, Coming to Apple TV and the rest -- are folders now instead of being hidden. Each opens its own canvas of shelves. 2026.7.31.6 - Open a shelf the way the website does - Opening a shelf now refetches it from the start instead of continuing from the copy the home page embedded. Personalised shelves return a different selection each time, so pairing a stale first page with freshly paged ones could leave gaps. 2026.7.31.5 - Shelves open to all their items - A canvas only sends each shelf's first page. Opening a shelf now follows its own paging token to the end, so "All Documentaries" is no longer 20 items when Apple has more. - Shelves with more to fetch show their count as "20+". 2026.7.31.4 - Every shelf on a tab, not just the first page - Channel canvases are paged: the response carries a nextToken offset to hand back for the next batch of shelves. The addon now walks that to the end, as the website does. - Apple TV+ goes from 10 shelves to 20, MLS from 5 to 13. Formula 1 sends no token and is a single page. 2026.7.31.3 - MLS and Formula 1 tabs, bonus content - NEW: The MLS and Formula 1 brand tabs from tv.apple.com's home page are now browsable alongside Apple TV+, each with all of its shelves. - NEW: "Bonus content" context-menu entry sits next to "Play trailer" on movies and shows (Ted Lasso has twelve bonus features). - The sports channels list clip types (highlights, interviews, key plays) that have no detail endpoint of their own but carry their stream in the shelf itself; that stream is kept so the clips play. - Navigation tiles (teams, Grand Prix rounds, browse rooms) no longer appear as playable items, since Apple gives them no stream at all. 2026.7.31.2 - Play trailers from the context menu - NEW: Movies and shows have a "Play trailer" context-menu entry. Apple lists a title's trailers in its detail response, each already carrying its own stream, so no extra request is needed. Titles with several trailers (Ted Lasso has seven) offer a chooser. - Trailers play without a subscription, so a missing media-user-token no longer blocks them. 2026.7.31.1 - Artwork no longer cut off - Apple ships both tall posters and wide stills for a title. The addon now reads each artwork's declared dimensions, sends the tall one to Kodi's poster slot and the wide one to thumb/fanart, and requests each at its own aspect ratio instead of forcing everything into a 16:9 box. - Titles with no tall artwork (episodes, sporting events) simply get no poster rather than a cropped one; logos and team badges are ignored. 2026.7.31 - Encrypted playback working (Kodi 22 required) - REQUIRES Kodi 22 with InputStream Adaptive 22 or newer. Playback uses the inputstream.adaptive.drm property, which the 21.x series does not have, so Kodi 21 support has been dropped rather than left broken. - NEW: Sporting events play, list their kick-off time, and report when a game has not started yet instead of failing. - Playback now works on Kodi 22 with InputStream Adaptive 22, using the new inputstream.adaptive.drm property (secure_decoder, pre_init_data). - Streams are limited to the lowest quality tier (360p by default), H.264 and SDR: Apple keys each tier separately and the CDM reports the higher tiers' keys as output restricted, cannot decode HEVC, and Kodi renders Dolby Vision with shifted colours. - Key ids are supplied to ISA via KEYID and the init segment's tenc box, which Apple leaves empty. 2026.7.30 - Experimental release (matched to real web client) - NEW: Apple ID sign-in rebuilt from a real tv.apple.com capture: authorize -> SRP init/complete with X-Apple-HC hashcash -> two-factor (trusted-device or SMS) -> session trust. Real OAuth client id. - NEW: Catalogue via confirmed UTS endpoints (Apple TV+ Originals channel canvas, search) with tokens scraped from the web shell. - NEW: Widevine playback pipeline: HLS via InputStream Adaptive with a local licence proxy that wraps the challenge in Apple's fpsRequest JSON envelope (Apple serves Widevine to non-Apple clients). - NOTE: Two playback tokens (account media-user-token and the per-title playback token) are still being reproduced; advanced settings accept pasted values to test playback meanwhile. SD only (Widevine L3).
